newsitem.title: ITALY: Iraqi police captain seeks asylum in Italy.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi police captain seeks asylum in Italy.

text.p: A captain from the Iraqi police force has asked for political asylum after illegally entering Italy, a police official said on Sunday.
The Iraqi, who was not named for security reasons, arrived in the southern toe of Italy along with 78 other illegal immigrants on Saturday.
The group sailed ashore in a flotilla of small boats and were quickly arrested.
The immigrants came from Pakistan, Bangladesh and Iraq. Police believe they were brought to Italian waters by a large ship and then transfered to the smaller boats.
